an9.93:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya nava dhammā bhāvetabbā.
an9.93:1.3: asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, āhāre paṭikkūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā, aniccasaññā, anicce dukkhasaññā, dukkhe anattasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā.
an9.93:1.4: rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya ime nava dhammā bhāvetabbāti.
